picks.title: FDA clears new AI-enabled stethoscopes
picks.excerpt: FDA cleared Eko Health's Core 300 AI-enabled stethoscope, combining analog listening with noise cancellation, amplification and real-time heart data display.
picks.rationale: A regulator decision: FDA clearance of a new AI stethoscope that clinicians use at the bedside. The 10-19 NEJM AI card was a validation study of AI auscultation, not a device clearance, so this is a separate event.

picks.title: 에이아이트릭스·강북삼성병원, 병원 행정 업무 AI 완전 자동화 추진
picks.excerpt: 에이아이트릭스와 강북삼성병원이 의료진 문서 부담을 줄이기 위해 병원 행정 업무의 AI 완전 자동화를 추진한다.
picks.rationale: Replaces the unverifiable NEJM AI ambient-documentation paper. A Korean hospital is adopting AI to automate clinician documentation and admin work, which falls under the _note's hospital-adoption and EMR-documentation scope. The article body is readable. The full URL (idxno=3014709) is not in history, which holds 3013809, 3014062, 3014060, 3013789, 3014484, 3014596 and 3014609. The enrichment pass should state whether this is a signed deployment or an MOU-stage plan.

picks.title: AI checks the trustworthiness of breast cancer AI models
picks.excerpt: University of Pittsburgh researchers built a model that flags when a breast cancer AI result may need a radiologist's second look.
picks.rationale: A safety layer for breast imaging AI: it flags which AI reads a radiologist should re-check. The tagged 10-07 card was about one health system replacing second readers with AI, which is a different event (a deployment, not this Pitt research).

picks.title: EpiSemoLLM localizes epileptogenic zones from seizure semiology
picks.excerpt: EpiSemoLLM, a domain-adapted language model, localizes epileptogenic zones from seizure semiology and performs comparably to or better than epileptologists across internal and external cohorts.
picks.rationale: A disease-specific LLM that matches epileptologists at localizing seizure origin for surgical planning, validated on external cohorts. The earlier epilepsy cards (10-09 EHR detection, 10-14 co-management) are different studies.

picks.title: FDA clears Elucid's new AI-enabled FFR-CT software
picks.excerpt: FDA cleared Elucid's AI-enabled FFR-IQ (FFR-CT) software for noninvasive coronary assessment, developed with clinician feedback.
picks.rationale: A second FDA clearance, this one for noninvasive coronary physiology from CT, which can reduce invasive catheter measurements. It is a different company, device and modality from pick 1. No FFR-CT card is in the 30-day history.
